summary.en-US: Podcasts in black and white — subscribe, download, listen, nothing else

description.en-US:
A podcast player with nothing on the screen but lines of text. Subscribe by pasting the
address of a feed or by sharing a link to the app; the episodes wait in one of three lists —
what is on the phone or already begun, what is new across all the channels, or one channel at
a time. An episode is downloaded or played straight over the connection, resumes exactly where
it was left, and once heard through is marked and its file let go.

Subscriptions travel as OPML, which any podcast app reads, and the settings — with the place
each episode was left — as a JSON file. Those two files are the whole of the synchronisation
with the desktop twin: there is no server and no account, and nothing leaves the phone but the
requests to the feeds themselves.

English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Russian; white on black or black on white,
three fonts, three text sizes.
